params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Irelia}} {{tip|abilities}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy champion hit, as well as one stack if she hits at least one non-champion. {{tip|Basic attacks}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will also refresh the duration.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Unsteady:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit by ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}}'' or ''{{ais|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}'' initial barrage are [[File:Bladesurge 2.png|20px]] marked. The mark can be consumed by ''{{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}''.
params.blurb4:
{{sbc|Ionian Fervor:}} For each stack, '''Irelia''' gains {{sti|{{as|bonus attack speed}}}}. At maximum stacks, her basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
Basic attacks against enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will also refresh the duration.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Irelia''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Ionian Fervor'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by her {{tip|abilities}}, or if she hits at least one non-champion, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on {{tip|basic attacks}} and ability hits against enemy {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monster|monsters}}, and {{tip|structures}}, and stacking up to 4 times.
params.description2: {{sbc|Ionian Fervor:}} For each stack, '''Irelia''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 25|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|10*4 to 25*4|key=%}}|attack speed}}. At maximum stacks, '''Irelia's''' basic attacks are empowered to deal {{as|{{pplevel|10 to 61}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pplevel|10*0.5 to 61*0.5}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}against structures.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Unsteady:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit by ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}}'' or ''{{ais|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}'' initial barrage are {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''Unsteady'' for 5 seconds. The mark can be consumed by ''{{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}''.
params.notes:
* {{Pending for test}}: Parry interactions ({{tip|block}} and {{tip|dodge}}).
* ''Ionian Fervor'' will not deal damage if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}, but its duration will be refreshed.
** {{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}} cannot be missed while '''Irelia''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, applying ''Ionian Fervor'' from the ability will not be prevented from that parry effect.
* ''Ionian Fervor'' stacks are represented by a counter under '''Irelia's''' [[health bar]]. It is highlighted while the ability is at its maximum effect.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Irelia}} {{tip|dashes}} through the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and {{tip|heal|healing}} herself.
params.blurb2: If this attack kills the target, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reset}}. Whenever a [[File:Bladesurge 2.png|20px]] mark is consumed, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' {{tip|dashes}} 100 units through the target enemy's location, and upon collision or dash completion, she deals {{as|physical damage}}, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and {{tip|heal|heals}} herself. ''Bladesurge'' deals {{as|{{pplevel|50 to 237}} '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|minions}}.
params.description2: ''Bladesurge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.2}} seconds upon collision of targets {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''{{cci|Bladesurge 2.png|Irelia/LoL#Ionian Fervor|Unsteady}}'', and is {{tt|reset|The check's cadence is 0.0625 seconds, or a bit less than 2 game ticks}} if the target dies to or during ''Bladesurge's'' dash.
params.description3: ''{{ai|Flawless Duet|Irelia}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.queue time: {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|This may not be valid in its entirety when the cooldown refreshes, due to other commands being canceled/queued automatically}}
params.notes:
* ''Bladesurge'' will be buffered and cast when the cooldown ends or is reset if the player attempts to cast it within {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the cooldown ending/resetting.
* ''Bladesurge'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* If the target dies during ''Bladesurge's'' dash, the cooldown is fully refunded and '''Irelia''' may also cast her other abilities during the dash.
* If the target dies to ''Bladesurge'' and was also {{as|marked|buzzword}}, the cooldown is still fully refunded.
* ''Bladesurge'' will only allow '''Irelia''' to dash through walls if there is enough space for her on the other side.
* ''Bladesurge'' deals its damage and consumes {{as|marks|buzzword}} when '''Irelia''' collides with the target, or at the end of the dash if the target moves away.
** ''Bladesurge'' will not deal damage if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} beforehand.
*** The damage will be dealt if the target is in collision range when the dash is interrupted however.
*** {{si|Flash}} will interrupt the {{tip|dash}} but '''Irelia''' will still collide with and deal damage to her target if the blink leaves her in contact with it at the new location.
** '''Irelia''' will complete her remaining dash distance even if the damage is dealt earlier.
** If the target is {{tip|untargetable}}, ''Bladesurge'' will instead deals its damage at the end of the dash, rather than on collision.
* '''Irelia''' will automatically be ordered to [[Basic attack#Acquisition|acquire]] and attack ''Bladesurge's'' target as soon as the dash completes. 
** If a different target than ''Bladesurge's'' is selected during the dash, she will [[Basic attack#Acquisition|acquire]] that different target instead.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' assumes a defensive stance with her blades to {{tip|channel|charge}} for up to {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she reduces incoming {{as|physical damage}} by {{pp|40 to 70|key=%}} {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}} and incoming {{as|magic damage}} by {{pp|40*0.5 to 70*0.5|key=%}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.5}}% per 100 AP)}}. Additionally, ''Defiant Dance's'' damage increases over the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds of the channel.
params.description2: ''Defiant Dance'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Defiant Dance's'' charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies around her and within a line, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 0.75|formula=20% per 0.075 seconds. ''This is capped at 0.75 seconds.''}}. She also retains the damage reduction for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|10*3 to 50*3}} {{as|(+ 120% AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
params.description4: ''Defiant Dance's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. {{ais|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} duration is paused during the charge; if {{ai|Ionian Fervor|Irelia}} has less than 1 second remaining when the charge starts, it is set to 1 second when the charge ends.''
params.range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|775|Recast swipe missile range}}|{{tt|895|Recast swipe total range}}}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Recast point blank radius}}|{{tt|120|Recast 'lollipop' radius at end of missile range}}}}
params.notes:
* Enemies around '''Irelia''' will be dealt the damage once the recast's cast time ends, while enemies within the line are dealt the damage via a missile that reaches the furthest targets after a {{rutngt|0.05}} delay after the recast's cast time.
* Quick Casting utilizes hold-and-release for the two casts.
* ''Defiant Dance'' reaches 100% physical damage reduction at {{as|{{pp|{{#expr:(1-0.4)/0.0007 round 2}} to {{#expr:(1-0.7)/0.0007 round 2}}}} AP}}.
* ''Defiant Dance'' reaches 100% magic damage reduction at {{as|{{pp|{{#expr:(1-0.2)/0.00035 round 2}} to {{#expr:(1-0.35)/0.00035 round 2}}}} AP}}.
* ''Defiant Dance'' will also recast automatically upon entering {{tip|resurrection}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** This refers to the recast.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Irelia''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|charge|cast=false|items=false|move=false|consume=Disabled, but can still use trinkets|spells=true,false,false,false,recasts|interrupts=death}}
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Irelia}} {{tip|channel|charges}} up for a brief moment, during which she gains damage reduction and increases ''Defiant Dance's'' damage. ''Defiant Dance'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. The charge cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' swipes her blades in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies nearby and within a line, increased based on how long she charged up.

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Irelia}} sends a blade to the target location for a short time.

''Flawless Duet'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration. The recast cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if ''Flawless Duet'' was recast automatically.
params.blurb3: Once both blades have been placed, they converge to deal {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun}} enemies within a line between.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' sends a blade to the target location for {{fd|3.5}} seconds. ''Flawless Duet'' can be recast after {{fd|0.15}} seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.
params.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Irelia''' sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if ''Flawless Duet'' was recast automatically.
params.description3: Once both blades have been placed, they fly toward each other regardless of distance and converge over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, afterwards dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within a line between them and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
params.description4: ''Flawless Duet's recast can be used during {{ai|Bladesurge|Irelia}} and the cast time of {{ai|Vanguard's Edge|Irelia}}, but is not used automatically while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities. Each of the blades' travel times are {{rutngt|0.25}}.''
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|2000|Missile speed to location}}|{{tt|Distance{{divided by}}{{fd|0.1}} s|Convergence missile always takes this amount of time to travel between blades regardless of range}}}}
params.notes:
* Both casts count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger and it will be considered as an ability activation. This is the only ability with this interaction in the game.
* ''Flawless Duet'' will recast automatically at its end during {{ai|Defiant Dance|Irelia}} despite being disabled.
* ''Flawless Duet'' will also recast automatically upon entering {{tip|resurrection}}.
* The outgoing blades will stop flight upon touching {{tip|projectile}} blocking effects. The converging blades will instead be destroyed upon contact with such effects.
** The blades will not stun nor deal damage if they fail to converge (i.e {{cai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}}).
* Both of ''Flawless Duet's'' casts will be buffered and cast when their cooldowns end if the player attempts to cast each within {{fd|0.3}} seconds of their cooldown ending.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Irelia}} launches a barrage of blades in the target direction that expand outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.blurb2: After expanding, the blades form a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for a short time. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Irelia''' launches a barrage of blades in the target direction, expanding outward upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second.
params.description2: After expanding, the blades drop on the ground, knocking all enemy units away from them, though not rendering them {{tip|airborne}}, and forming a spade-shaped perimeter around the enemy champion hit for {{fd|2.5}} seconds that grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. Enemies that pass through the blades for the first time are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description3: ''The perimeter will point at the same angle '''Irelia''' cast it from, but based on the target's center.''
params.notes:
* ''Vanguard's Edge'' deals {{tip|area damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}. The damage dealt by the blades after they land on the ground is additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage|indirect}}.
* Enemies that cross the perimeter are '''not''' {{as|marked|buzzword}} ''Unsteady''.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Vanguard's Edge'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Irelia''' if she moves during the cast time.
* In addition to its {{tip|projectile}}, ''Vanguard's Edge'' will check for enemy champions within a {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 90-unit radius area from the projectile's origin point.
** The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't.
* The blades will still expand if the champion hit by the blades is protected by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
* The {{tip|sight}} is granted in a {{tt|1350|estimated}} unit radius at the location of the enemy champion at the time of being hit and can be blocked by terrain.
* If this spell is cast while there are blades from a previous ''Vanguard's Edge'' still active, the previous blades will disappear.
